description: This file is a shell script used for testing 'git blame' heuristics, specifically related to fuzzy matching, range overlaps, variable renaming, and reorderings within source code files. It contains test setup code, test cases with code snippets, and expected results for blame analysis.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful completion, executing a shell command and verifying its output.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a file with given lines, used to set up test scenarios.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or inputs for equality.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the timestamp or performs a wait to simulate time progression between commits.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for looping over test cases.
